result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Sparkling may assign to affiliates and transaction successors without consent; Garman's other consent rights are subject to a reasonableness standard; Garman remains subject to Sparkling's consent and may never assign to a Sparkling competitor; and Sparkling's change of control creates no termination right. It is not strictly minimal because it also adds reorganization, share-sale, suspension, and repricing protections beyond the stated playbook. The Section 20(d) cross-reference generally preserves the separate restrictions on transferring, leasing, exporting, or sublicensing the Work, although the placement of the exception creates some grammatical ambiguity about its scope.
